claim_text: Lag-7 seasonal-naive baseline outperforms historical mean and last-value heuristics on the 28-day development validation block (MAE 9.61 vs 12.56 and 12.11, sMAPE 10.13% vs 13.48% and 12.96%), confirming weekly seasonality as the primary deterministic pattern.
decision_bound: Reference baseline for TD2 models; not validated across all operating regimes
safety_or_fallback_rule: Maintain safety stock buffer; flag holiday and promotion shifts
limitation: Single 28-day window; does not account for censored demand during stockouts
